name: Roast Chicken
source: Two-stage roast; adapted from RecipeTin Eats
steps: Heat the oven to 220C/430F. Pat the chicken very dry.
Rub all over with oil and salt; put the halved lemon and garlic in the cavity.
Lower to 180C/350F and roast ~20 min per 500 g (about 1 h 5 min for 1.6 kg).
Done when the thickest part reads 75C/165F and juices run clear.
Rest 15 min loosely tented with foil before carving.
notes: Total time scales with weight: 10 min sear + ~20 min per 500 g at 180C. Always check with a thermometer (75C) rather than time alone.
